title: Credits and licences
intro_md: Phobos stands on a lot of other people's work. The main pieces:

components.name: ares
components.role: The multi-system emulator Phobos is built on
components.by: the ares team, Near et al.

components.name: paraLLEl-RDP
components.role: The N64's graphics on Vulkan, modified by Phobos

components.name: sljit
components.role: The JIT compiler under the N64 and PSP recompilers

components.name: SDL 3.2.30
components.role: Window, input and sound for the desktop program

components.name: HIDAPI
components.role: Inside SDL's joystick code, on Linux, Windows and macOS
components.by: Alan Ott, Signal 11 Software, and the libusb/hidapi team

components.name: FFmpeg
components.role: The PSP's ATRAC3, ATRAC3plus and MP3 sound and H.264 movies (libavcodec, libavutil)

components.name: MoltenVK
components.role: Vulkan on macOS, bundled in the macOS app
components.by: The Brenwill Workshop Ltd., for the Khronos Group

components.name: SPIRV-Cross
components.role: Its parser and its GLSL, MSL and reflection compilers, inside MoltenVK
components.by: Arm Limited, The Brenwill Workshop Ltd., Bradley Austin Davis and Hans-Kristian Arntzen

components.name: AppImage runtime
components.role: type2-runtime, the start of the Linux AppImage, which mounts or extracts the image after it

components.name: libadrenotools
components.role: Custom Turnip drivers on Adreno GPUs

components.name: libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and compiler-rt
components.role: LLVM's runtime libraries, the Android NDK's, in the app; compiler-rt also in the macOS app

components.name: sse2neon
components.role: x86 SIMD intrinsics on ARM's NEON

components.name: MAME
components.role: Neo Geo cartridge decryption and banking, the zoom table and the RTC protocol

components.name: C-BIOS
components.role: The bundled MSX and MSX2 system ROMs

components.name: Systematic console icons
components.role: The console art in the app's Library, recoloured for each theme

more_md: And the LZMA SDK, miniz, Zstandard, xxHash, TZXFile, qoi/qon, puff, font-rs, the ZX Spectrum ROMs (Amstrad's, redistributed with its permission), Khronos's OpenGL and EGL headers (MIT-style), the MinGW-w64 runtime in the Windows build, the Android and Kotlin libraries, and the app's fonts (Press Start 2P, Galmuri, VT323, DotGothic16, Bangers, Comic Neue and M PLUS 1, under the SIL Open Font License). Inside SDL 3.2.30 are yuv2rgb, stb_image's JPEG decoder and SDL_rotate, and on Linux the X11 EDID parser and XSETTINGS client, imKStoUCS, code from xdg-user-dirs, the Wayland protocols and PipeWire's SPA header code. Inside MoltenVK are SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Headers and cereal, and linked into the AppImage runtime are musl, libfuse, squashfuse, zstd, zlib and mimalloc. Every component's licence, in full, is in [LICENSE](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/LICENSE).
